scope: Focused investigation of an unchanged workflow security-test failure on the existing local development server. No application or backend changes.

environment.browser: Node fetch and undici; no browser involved

sources.qualification: Relevant backend/test/manifests were unchanged when the failure was reproduced. A historical checkout/runtime was not separately executed; this is not proof that an earlier environment had the same failure.

originalFailure.test: CSRF, malformed bodies, and immutable site protection reject safely
originalFailure.sequence: Authenticated GET 200, adversarial-origin POST 403, missing-origin POST 403, next authenticated GET 400

freshSingleConnectionComparison.client: New undici Agent({ connections: 1, pipelining: 1 }) per case

focusedOriginalTest.fixture: Temporary copy of the original first three workflow subtests, ending before content-mutation fixtures

normal.result: Same original line 149 failure; 2 passing child tests, 1 failing child test; parent also failed

closedTransport.result: All 3 child tests and parent passed

focusedOriginalTest.temporaryWrapper: Original fetch preserved; a wrapper merges existing headers and adds Connection: close to each request. This comparison wrapper is not used by the delivered test harness.

interpretation.confidence: High confidence in a rejected-body/persistent-connection development transport problem; precise parser mechanism not instrumented.
interpretation.evidence: The API GET implementation does not return an empty 400. The installed Vite clientError handler emits this exact bare HTTP 400 with Connection: close. Fresh-connection reproduction depends on the rejected request having a body.
interpretation.limitations: No production deployment was tested. Ordinary pooled fetch is sensitive to which connection is reused, explaining the inconsistent location of the follow-up 400.

deliveredHarnessAdjustment.change: Only the two deliberately CSRF-rejected POST requests explicitly close their connections. All strict 403 assertions and the normal shared request helper remain unchanged.
deliveredHarnessAdjustment.reason: Avoid poisoning the connection used by the following valid GET, while continuing to exercise the actual CSRF rejection.
deliveredHarnessAdjustment.verification: Investigator did not rerun after edit; root subsequently ran the ordinary complete suite: 322 passed, 0 failed (see finalVerification).

dataHandling: No credentials, cookies, inquiry contents or content records retained in evidence. Focused requests only read existing content and exercise rejected operations; no content fixture was modified.

finalVerification.harnessChange: Only the two intentional CSRF-rejection requests use Connection: close. All original status assertions remain strict.
